n8de60abc99.headline: Parliamentarian: International institutions will not refuse Egypt’s request to cancel some debts
n8de60abc99.summary: An Egyptian parliamentarian stated that international institutions are unlikely to refuse Egypt's request to cancel some debts to ease economic strain from the pandemic.
n8de60abc99.why: Egypt is a key African economy facing fiscal pressures; debt relief could improve its financial stability and economic recovery prospects.
